- Clicking a white square in the grid turns it gray (or to light green N)
- Clicking a purple dot in the left panel creates/restores white squares in the grid matching the cross pattern
So the cycle is:
1. Grid starts with white squares in cross pattern
2. I can click white squares to turn them gray
3. I can click purple dots to restore white squares

- After third click (55, 35): that square became N (light green)

Hmm, maybe the white squares first turn to N (light green) and then to g (gray) over time or with additional actions?

- All 4 grid squares (3x3 each)

So the 4th click triggered a big animation that affected the top bar, all grid squares, and the HUD. This might have been a "completion" event for turning all white squares.
